4. MF-17 settle in tick_construction: after kind=建筑 conversion, settle 营造银:
```rust
// MF-17：建成即结清——营造银余额按「投入」核销为建筑本体（物化结清，死账闭合）
let invest = w.entities.get(&id).and_then(|e| e.fields.get("投入").copied()).unwrap_or(0.0);
if invest > 0.0 {
let settled = w.material.consume_from_cell(&region, "营造银", invest);
if settled > 1e-9 {
w.material.ledger.push(format!(
"SETTLE {building}@{region} 银={settled:.2}（营造银→建筑本体物化结清）"));
}
}
```
Note: current code re-reads entity after conversion — get 投入 before or after kind change doesn't matter.
5. work pairing: replace the ("work", true) block:
```rust

let earn = 0.15 * (0.5 + integrity);

// 人物随身银 +earn ↔ 源叶财富总量 -earn（μ -= earn/n）

.find(|(_, l)| l.ctx.get("region").map(|r| r == region).unwrap_or(false))
.map(|(id, _)| id.clone());

paired = true;
}
}
}
